# Error Studio

> Error Studio is a photography and film studio based in Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu. It photographs weddings and events and makes films, edits and albums. This guide links to the studio's own pages; availability and scope should be checked directly with the studio.

Studio address: Co-operative Nagar, Koothapakkam, Pathirikuppam, Tamil Nadu 607401, India. Google Maps listing: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=ERROR+STUDIO&query_place_id=ChIJW5keDM-jVDoR8cdDOLM8_UA
Contact number displayed on the website: +91 99440 36606. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/errorstudio.official/

## Official pages

- [Home](https://www.errorstudio.in/): Overview and studio contact.
- [About](https://www.errorstudio.in/about): Studio and approach.
- [Services](https://www.errorstudio.in/service): Wedding photography, cinematic videography, creative editing, brand and commercial work, album design, event coverage and cinematic teasers.
- [Wedding photography](https://www.errorstudio.in/service/wedding-photography): Wedding photography for Cuddalore, Villupuram and Pondicherry.
- [Pre-wedding photography](https://www.errorstudio.in/service/pre-wedding-photography): Pre-wedding shoots for Cuddalore, Villupuram and Pondicherry.
- [Portrait photography](https://www.errorstudio.in/service/portrait-photography): Portrait photography for Cuddalore, Villupuram and Pondicherry.
- [Portfolio](https://www.errorstudio.in/portfolio): Selected real shoot photographs.
- [FAQ](https://www.errorstudio.in/faq): The studio's published booking and delivery answers.
- [Contact](https://www.errorstudio.in/contact): Contact details and availability enquiries. The online enquiry form is currently being updated; use the published contact or booking number instead.
